phases.objective: Provide an independently triggered, non-content-writing bootstrap that can activate the existing Work Map Recovery workflow without returning repository write authority to pull-request validation workflows.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Exact /activate-work-map-recovery <head_sha> issue comment or typed workflow_dispatch
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The bootstrap validates one exact current same-repository pull request, enables the existing independent Recovery workflow, delegates one typed exact-PR recovery run, and publishes structured evidence without consuming authorization or mutating repository content.
steps: Require issue_comment or workflow_dispatch only; never accept pull_request or push.
Require write-level repository permission for the comment actor or exact typed manual confirmation.
Read the open non-Draft same-repository pull request targeting main.
Require the governed branch, exact requested head SHA, one-time Work Map marker, and behind_by=0.
Dispatch the existing Recovery workflow with pr_number and RECOVER_SPEC_KIT_WORK_MAP_AUTOFIX.
Observe the delegated run ID and publish bounded JSON plus PR evidence.
Leave marker consumption, writer enablement, Work Map generation, commit, and push to the existing Recovery and sole writer workflows.
assertions: The bootstrap has actions:write, contents:read, issues:write, and pull-requests:read with no contents:write.
The bootstrap contains no pull_request or push trigger.
The command is bound to one exact lowercase 40-character head SHA.
The target PR must be current with main and the remote head must equal the requested SHA.
The bootstrap dispatches Recovery only and never dispatches the sole writer directly.
The bootstrap does not consume the one-time marker, commit, push, mutate protected refs, force push, deploy, access providers, databases, migrations, credentials, or external business systems.
Structured evidence declares direct_repository_mutation=false, authorization_consumed=false, protected_branch_mutation=false, force_push=false, and secrets_included=false.

phases.objective: Delegate to the existing Recovery workflow while preserving that workflow as the authorization consumer and the Spec Kit Work Map Autofix workflow as the sole remote writer.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Bootstrap workflow contract and executable regression
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: No duplicate Work Map producer or authorization consumer is introduced.
steps: Inspect the bootstrap workflow as trusted default-branch code.
Verify it enables and dispatches only the existing Recovery workflow.
Verify marker consumption remains absent from the bootstrap.
Verify no git commit, git push, writer dispatch, or generated path mutation exists.
assertions: The Recovery workflow remains the only one-time authorization consumer.
spec-kit-work-map-autofix.yml remains the sole remote Work Map writer.
Pull-request validation workflows remain read-only under the repository-write separation contract.

phases.objective: Fail closed on untrusted actors, malformed commands, stale heads, missing authorization, protected targets, disabled Recovery readback, rejected dispatch, or unobserved delegated runs.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Candidate changes to the bootstrap workflow or its contract
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Regression and lifecycle checks reject any mixed PR-write path or unbound delegation before merge.
steps: Validate workflow syntax and static authority boundaries.
Require exact SHA, branch, marker, actor permission, and main freshness.
Reject contents:write, pull_request triggers, direct writer dispatch, marker consumption, git commit, git push, and force push.
Publish bounded evidence even when activation or dispatch is blocked.
assertions: No repository content mutation is performed by the bootstrap.
No secrets are included in evidence.

phases.objective: This repository-control bootstrap has no provider canary authority.
This repository-control bootstrap performs no Production action or deployment.
